backlog.targetBehavior: Support upstream-style named command arguments, richer command templates, and config parity across local/project/user scopes.
backlog.currentGap: Custom commands load, but argument semantics and config parity are simpler than upstream.
backlog.subsystem: Go command loader, shared command contracts, desktop command UI
backlog.acceptanceCriteria: Named placeholders work end-to-end, config precedence is documented, and parity audit marks command system as matched or desktop-adapted.

backlog.targetBehavior: Match upstream tool orchestration, stop/continue semantics, and richer tool result shaping.
backlog.currentGap: Core loop exists but deeper orchestration parity is still partial.
backlog.subsystem: Go agent loop, tool result modeling, WebSocket event stream
backlog.acceptanceCriteria: Tool calls, denials, retries, and completions render consistently and match audit expectations.

backlog.targetBehavior: Provide upstream-grade approval semantics and diff-aware mutation review.
backlog.currentGap: Approvals and patching are strong but not fully upstream-equivalent.
backlog.subsystem: Approval broker, desktop approval UI, patch/edit engine
backlog.acceptanceCriteria: Approvals expose intent, affected files, and diff previews for all risky mutations.

backlog.targetBehavior: Expand from current file-scoped LSP and stdio-only MCP to richer upstream behavior.
backlog.currentGap: Definitions/references exist, but workspace depth and MCP transport breadth are still partial.
backlog.subsystem: LSP client, MCP client, tool schema exposure, desktop diagnostics panels
backlog.acceptanceCriteria: Parity audit upgrades LSP and MCP classifications and documents supported transports/capabilities.

backlog.targetBehavior: Use graph and session lineage to influence answers with stronger semantic ranking and symbol/reference relationships.
backlog.currentGap: Lineage-aware retrieval exists, but symbol/reference graph semantics remain shallow.
backlog.subsystem: Neo4j store, repo indexer, prompt context builder
backlog.acceptanceCriteria: Repo graph stores true symbol/reference relationships and retrieval is traceably better across follow-up tasks.

backlog.targetBehavior: Bring subtask and compaction behavior closer to upstream continuation semantics.
backlog.currentGap: Child sessions exist, but summary lineage and nested-task behavior are still partial.
backlog.subsystem: Session model, compaction flow, memory/session linking
backlog.acceptanceCriteria: Parent/subtask context continues predictably after compaction and is surfaced in audit outputs.

backlog.targetBehavior: Preserve upstream information architecture in a desktop-native interface.
backlog.currentGap: Desktop UX is solid but still less polished and less dense than upstream terminal flows.
backlog.subsystem: React desktop renderer, command palette, activity stream, session panels
backlog.acceptanceCriteria: Audit classifies presentation parity as desktop-adapted with no major missing interaction patterns.
